en: Let's look back at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>first murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

It was late last night. The culprit was in
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>empty room on the 4th floor<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit was preparing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>seance murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>
they had planned.

To use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>floorboard<CLT=cltNORMAL> as a seesaw, they had
to cut the <CLT=cltSTRONG>crosspiece<CLT=cltNORMAL> supporting it.

The plan was to make the same preparations
for all <CLT=cltSTRONG>three empty rooms<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

This would divert suspicion away from the
culprit and to whoever picked a room.

To cut the crosspieces, they needed a <CLT=cltSTRONG>saw<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I imagine they got one from the warehouse.

They were planning to cut the
crosspieces in all three rooms.

However, when the culprit was working on
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>middle room<CLT=cltNORMAL>, the unexpected happened...

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Angie<CLT=cltNORMAL> walked into that room and saw
the culprit making their preparations.

She needed some fire for the ritual, and
had gone to the room for a <CLT=cltSTRONG>candle<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

At that point, the culprit had not finished
the setup and was just cutting crosspieces.

Angie might not have concluded that it
was tied to some kind of murder plan.

But now that Angie had seen it, the
culprit couldn't use the seesaw trick.

Any other person might have just given
up. But not our culprit.

The culprit took the floorboard they loosened
and struck the unsuspecting Angie in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>head<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit did not want to give up on
their plan and had to <CLT=cltSTRONG>improvise<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

They wrapped <CLT=cltSTRONG>duct tape<CLT=cltNORMAL> around
Angie's injury to stop the bleeding.

Then they picked up her unconscious body
and carried her to her <CLT=cltSTRONG>research lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

While she was unconscious, the culprit
hurried to tie up this loose end.

But because they were in a hurry,
they made a crucial oversight.

They didn't notice the <CLT=cltSTRONG>duct tape<CLT=cltNORMAL> had
peeled off, and was under Angie's body.

Without that evidence, we may never
have figured out the culprit's trick.

Carrying the supplies they needed, the
culprit returned to the Ultimate Art Lab...
locked the <CLT=cltSTRONG>front door<CLT=cltNORMAL> from inside...

and took out the <CLT=cltSTRONG>katana<CLT=cltNORMAL> they
brought from their own lab.

They then stabbed Angie in the back
of the neck, finally killing her.

Then, to further confuse us, the culprit
attempted to make a <CLT=cltSTRONG>locked-room mystery<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

First, they used rope from the warehouse and
hung <CLT=cltSTRONG>four effigies<CLT=cltNORMAL> upside-down.
There were two reasons for this.

To overwhelm the room
with an occult atmosphere...

And the other was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>key<CLT=cltNORMAL> to locking
the room.

The culprit stuck the katana into
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaede's effigy<CLT=cltNORMAL> near the <CLT=cltSTRONG>rear entrance<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...and spun the effigy around
to twist up the rope.

After enough turns, the culprit let go
and headed for the rear door.

Once released, the effigy began spinning,
and the gold leaf katana with it.

The handle of the katana then hit the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>sliding lock<CLT=cltNORMAL>, locking the door.

A difficult trick, but remember that the lock
was so loose it moved at the slightest touch.

The culprit also would have had the
opportunity to attempt it many times.

Once complete, the door was locked,
but the duct tape was left behind.

Perhaps the culprit noticed it, but
by that point it was too late.

The room was sealed. There was no way
for them to get back inside.

Then, this morning, we opened up the
room and discovered Angie's body...

But the culprit wasn't finished.
They wanted <CLT=cltSTRONG>one more murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

To do that, they manipulated us into
performing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>seance<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Of the three empty rooms, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>middle one<CLT=cltNORMAL>
was chosen for the seance.

I was invited by Kokichi to take Keebo's place
in the seance.

Tenko volunteered to be the medium. But...
she never imagined it would get her killed.

To perform the seance, the culprit claimed
they needed something for Tenko...

A <CLT=cltSTRONG>small stone<CLT=cltNORMAL> that Himiko had
brought from the courtyard.

Tenko, at the culprit's request, bowed
her head until it was touching the stone.

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>position<CLT=cltNORMAL> was instrumental in
making sure the murder went as planned.

Next, Kokichi and I placed the <CLT=cltSTRONG>iron cage<CLT=cltNORMAL> over
Tenko, in the middle of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic circle<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit then volunteered to drape the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>white cloth<CLT=cltNORMAL> over the iron cage.

We didn't realize it at the time, but that
was a deliberate decision by the culprit.

They needed to set up the <CLT=cltSTRONG>murder weapon<CLT=cltNORMAL>
that was used to kill Tenko.

While they were covering the cage with the
cloth, they secretly placed the sickle.

Finally, four of us <CLT=cltSTRONG>placed<CLT=cltNORMAL> the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>wooden statue<CLT=cltNORMAL> on top of the cage.

The culprit used the weight of the statue to
keep the murder weapon in place.

After the preparations were complete,
we began the seance.

In complete darkness, we each stood in one
corner and sang "<CLT=cltSTRONG>The Caged Child<CLT=cltNORMAL>" song.

When the song finished, the soul of the
dead was supposed to enter the medium...

but our culprit had another plan—to
commit a murder in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>darkness<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Right after we started singing, the culprit
began making their way toward Tenko.

It would have been quite difficult to do in
total darkness, but our culprit had a <CLT=cltSTRONG>guide<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

They used the lines of the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>magic circle drawn with salt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The culprit felt for the salt and used it
to guide them along.

And when the culprit reached the
center of the circle...

they found the floorboard that had its
crosspiece cut off the night before...

Then lifted up their foot and
<CLT=cltSTRONG>stomped down<CLT=cltNORMAL> hard on the floorboard!
The floorboard lifted up like a seesaw...

...and pushed Tenko's body up toward
the ceiling of the cage.

Tenko was stabbed in the back of the neck
by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>sickle on the top of the cage<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

She was killed right before our eyes
and we didn't even see it!

After committing the crime, the culprit
followed the salt back to their corner...

...finished the ritual, and had
us light the candles.

We followed the culprit's directions and
removed the equipment used for the seance...
...and discovered Tenko's body.

And while we were all focused on the body,
the culprit picked up the sickle...

...and dropped it under the floor through the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hole in the corner<CLT=cltNORMAL> of the room.

Ironically...the final step of the murder
was unwittingly carried out by us.

The culprit had planned the murder so that we
would unintentionally destroy some evidence.

That evidence was the <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic circle<CLT=cltNORMAL>
that the culprit used to navigate in the dark.

However, the culprit didn't know that
Keebo had taken a <CLT=cltSTRONG>picture<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

He really saved us. Without that, we wouldn't
know what changes were made to the circle.

But now we know for certain. And we know
the culprit <CLT=cltSTRONG>drew the magic circle<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Korekiyo Shinguji, the Ultimate Anthropologist<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
You're the culprit behind these murders!

Who was the culprit with the
saw in the empty room?
What weapon knocked Angie unconscious?

What was compressing the injury
on Angie's head while she was carried?
What weapon killed Angie?
Whose effigy was stabbed with the katana?
The handle of the spinning katana...

When Angie's body was found,
who unlocked the door?

What object did Tenko rest her
forehead on during the seance?

What weapon did the culprit
set up on the iron cage?

Who besides Kokichi was responsible
for extinguishing the candles?

How was the culprit able to move around
in the darkness during the seance?
When the culprit approached the cage...
How did the magic circle get erased?
